name: radiance_priest
notes: The Priest's sun as a front: a white-gold blade 81 px tall edged hot red-orange, three triangular sun-spikes (like the points on its halo-sun) pulsing on twos, hard star rays, shafts streaming back, cinders off the floor, a glare line. Chest-high: roll through it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 86; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 59; place that point on the ring's position.
